title: splitGraph dependency_graph
description: On-disk JSON format written by splitGraph::write_dependency_graph(). A typed dependency graph describing biomedical dataset structure. Schema version 0.4.0 (package 0.6.0): documents the optional temporal node attributes used by the timeline validation rules (Sample collection_time, index_time, outcome_time, event_time; FeatureSet feature_window_end, collection_time; Outcome outcome_time, event_time). Additive over 0.3.0.

edge_sources.description: Provenance of each edge set that went into the graph, keyed by relation (edge_type). Records the source columns and, for thresholded pairwise relations, the threshold that was applied when the edges were built (kinship minimum for subject_related_to, distance maximum for sample_adjacent_to).

attrs.description: Node attributes (free-form). Temporal attributes read by the timeline rules (Sample collection_time, index_time, outcome_time, event_time; FeatureSet feature_window_end, collection_time; Outcome outcome_time, event_time) are a date string "YYYY-MM-DD", a date-time string "YYYY-MM-DD[T ]HH:MM[:SS]" with an optional Z or +HH:MM offset (UTC when absent), an ISO 8601 duration string with fixed-length units W/D/H/M/S (e.g. "P1DT2H", "-PT30M", "PT0S"; emitted by write_dependency_graph() for R difftime attributes), or a number of unspecified unit. Numbers are compared only with numbers and durations only with durations.
